verdict.rationale: ADP's API Central add-on lets developers create integration projects with security certificates, assign specific APIs to each project, and authenticate via OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect. That implies per-project credentials limited to the APIs assigned. However, the evidence never explicitly describes fine-grained scopes, read-only or least-privilege permission settings, or agent-specific credentials, and it is unclear how far API Central applies to RUN specifically. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission granularity documentation, least-privilege or read-only credential options, agent-oriented credential issuance, confirmation of RUN coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Immediately after activation, developers can create integration projects and security certificates
Developers can find and assign APIs, generate code samples, and observe API performance
API Central leverages OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization to ensure only authorized users and systems can access the data
Manage both internal and external users; Generate certificates
